method_translation.KISS: one clear human idea; remove anything not earning its place
method_translation.Hormozi: make value, pain and desired movement concrete without hype
method_translation.Yoichi Feral: allow an unexpected, sharp human turn when it increases recognition
method_translation.Schwartz: meet the audience at the awareness level already present in the signal
method_translation.Berger: make the idea easy to remember, retell or share when naturally useful
method_translation.Cialdini_etico: use proof, consistency, reciprocity or authority only when truthful and non-coercive
